node.statement: Definitional bridge and failure of implication. At every amplification, a delta-inclusion must first be a delta-homomorphism by def-extended-delta-inclusion. The allowed source definition of a delta-homomorphism in the *-algebra setting imposes gamma_n(X^dagger)=gamma_n(X)^dagger exactly. Conditional node 1.2 instead bounds the norm of the difference by K_hom*e*||X||. For e>0 this is only membership of the difference in a nonzero-radius ball and logically does not force the difference to vanish. Enlarging the defect parameter from K_hom*e to C_merge*e changes only the permitted approximate unit and multiplicative errors; it cannot replace the separate exact involution equation. Hence the claimed definitional inference is invalid without an additional exact involution-compatibility hypothesis, and no extended isomorphism conclusion follows from the listed conditional inputs.
